prompt: The sender protocol address in an ARP packet is the four bytes `c6 33 64 07` (198.51.100.7).

trace.label: On a little-endian CPU, `*(const uint32_t *)a` equals

explain: Network order puts the first address byte in the most significant position. Reading the memory as a native integer on a little-endian machine reverses the bytes, and the cast can also be misaligned. Build the value byte by byte.
